name: Swelling Forces
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Steel yourself for your time in the ruins, young one... you will not be granted free passage there.

Scores of cursed Highborne, now known as naga, roam the once great city. Travel northeast and dispatch them from this land.

What they once were... is no more. If they aid the Twilight's Hammer, they can bring only further pain to the forests that once gave them shelter.

War is what they seek, champion. War... is what we will bring.
narrative.objectives: Eliminate 12 Stormscale Myrmidons, 8 Stormscale Sorceresses, and 6 Stormscale Warriors for Arbal at the Grove of the Ancients.
narrative.offerRewardText: Do not fret, young one. To pillage one's own home for some dark master...It is unforgivable.
